_readme: Evidence for every GPT Image 2 capability CineBraid relies on.
This family is the C2a proof that the compiler is not video-shaped: it is a still
image model, on a different vendor, with a different input contract, and it compiles
through the same core with no change to generation-compiler.js.
OpenAI is the model's own vendor, so its documentation is model evidence for hosted
behaviour. It is NOT evidence about fal, which is how CineBraid actually reaches this
model today - fal's narrowing, if any, belongs to data/provider-surfaces.json.

sources.note: CineBraid's own shipped prompt profiles for this family, authored before C2a. Used only where OpenAI publishes no number.

capabilities.claim: A mask must match the input image's format and size, be under 50MB, and contain an alpha channel.
Both edges must be multiples of 16 pixels.
Long edge to short edge ratio must not exceed 3:1.
Total pixels must be between 655,360 and 8,294,400.

capabilities.note: Each partial costs 100 additional output tokens.

capabilities.claim: input_fidelity is not settable; every image input is processed at high fidelity.

capabilities.note: From data/model-profiles.json gpt-image-2/t2i limits.maxReferences. OpenAI's guide shows multiple inputs but publishes no ceiling; the shipped profile's number is retained rather than replaced with a guess.

notEstablished.claim: A seed or any other deterministic-reproduction control.
notEstablished.status: no OpenAI image documentation reachable from here documents one
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: capabilities.flags.seed is false. A supplied seed produces an unsupported coverage entry and a warning; no seed is invented.

notEstablished.status: explicitly NOT supported - the guide states requests with background: transparent are not supported for this model
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: Recorded as a caveat on the catalogue entry so a cut-out workflow is planned another way rather than discovered at dispatch.

notEstablished.status: the guide states no explicit prompt length limit
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: constraints.maxPromptCharacters is null. Nothing refuses on length for this model.

notEstablished.claim: Whether fal narrows any of the above.
notEstablished.status: fal publishes no narrowing that CineBraid has read
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: The fal offering records an empty constraints block, which means 'no narrowing established' and NOT 'no narrowing exists'.

promptingPolicySources.note: data/model-profiles.json has carried four authored profiles for this family since long before C2a - t2i, edit, multi-reference and blocking, each with rules and section orders. model-packs/gpt-image-2.js encodes that existing editorial policy as a versioned playbook. It is NOT presented as vendor prompting guidance, because it is not: no OpenAI prompt-writing guide was read into this record.
